plugins.name: claude2figma
plugins.description: Design System compliance harness for Claude + Figma. Enforces library-first components, token binding, and automated QA — so AI-generated designs stay on-spec.

skills.name: component-rules
skills.description: Triggers when building any UI element in Figma — 'create a card', 'build a nav', 'add a section', 'make a component'. Enforces library-first component lookup, correct Auto Layout structure, and semantic node naming. For visual property binding (colors, text styles, spacing values), defer to figma-style-binding.
skills.description_zh: 在Figma建设卡片导航区块组件时，先查库组件、使用正确Auto Layout和语义节点命名；视觉属性绑定转figma-style-binding。

skills.name: figma-preflight
skills.description: Triggers on 'let's start', 'begin', 'preflight', 'start the session', or when a Figma file URL is first shared. Verifies MCP connection, reads CLAUDE.md, audits connected libraries, and loads a Token Map of all Styles and Variables — required before any design work.
headings: Step C — Styles + Variables + Components (single use_figma call)
skills.description_zh: 在Figma会话开始或首次接收文件URL时，验证MCP、读取CLAUDE.md、审计已连接库并加载全部样式变量的Token Map，作为设计前检查。

skills.name: figma-style-binding
skills.description: Triggers on any visual property change in Figma — creating text, setting colors, adjusting spacing/padding/gap/radius. Enforces that ALL values bind to Figma Styles or Variables, never hardcoded. Includes post-write QA verification.
skills.description_zh: 在Figma创建文字、设色或修改间距内边距圆角等视觉属性时，将全部值绑定Styles或Variables，避免硬编码，并进行写入后QA。

skills.name: reference-interpreter
skills.description: Triggers when user shares a screenshot, image, URL, or design description — or says 'analyze this', 'make a brief', 'interpret this reference'. Outputs a structured Design Brief mapping visual intent to design system tokens. Waits for 'confirmed' before designing.
skills.description_zh: 解读用户提供的截图、图片、URL或设计描述，生成将视觉意图映射至设计令牌的结构化简报；用户确认后才开始设计。
